method: Pipelined average: N back-to-back calls with one device drain, median over the rounds. Generation compares the composed reference step and the fused step in one process, alternating every round (GenerationWorkspace::composed_step). Training compares two binaries that differ only in the teacher pass (per-position loop against the position-batched pass), runs interleaved. V0 model config, N = 128 raw peaks, synthetic spectra, random-init weights: timings are structural.
note: The composed generation reference already includes the transpose-free SSM step, so the fused step's gain over the code before this work is somewhat larger than the paired ratio.
